chain_words.nuance: to harm something so that it works less well
to cause injury or negative effects
to weaken something's quality or ability
to damage something so badly that it cannot be used
to damage something completely so that it no longer exists

explanation: These words all describe harming or spoiling something, from partial damage to complete destruction.

usage_notes.difference: 'Damage' means harm that may be repaired; 'destroy' means harm so complete that the thing no longer exists.
